task.description: Validate the design artefact at src/design/uat-tenant-url.md for UAT Tenant URL feature (UAT-TM-01 through UAT-TM-04). Check: (1) every acceptance criterion in every MUST requirement has a design element, (2) no implementation code is present, (3) all public function signatures are listed, (4) error taxonomy exists, (5) dependencies documented, (6) classification per templates/lego-catalog.md is correct. All are Type E prose designs.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement acceptance criterion has a corresponding design element
No implementation code in the design (interfaces/signatures only)
Function signatures for getKeycloakToken(), refreshTokenIfNeeded(), resolveTenantContext() are specified
Resolution chain documented: company_id -> GET /api/v1/tenants/{slug} -> realm -> token
Error handling documented (tenant not found, realm unreachable)
All changes are backward-compatible with existing pipeline tests
